part2.question: A piece of local news that people are interested in

segments.v: I want to talk about news about motorbikes in Hà Nội. Last year, the government said that petrol motorbikes will not be allowed in the city centre from 2026. They want to reduce air pollution. I saw this news on my phone. Then I saw it on TV and on Facebook. Everyone talked about it. My parents also talked about it at dinner. Many people are involved, like the government, people who ride motorbikes, delivery drivers and electric motorbike companies. People were interested because most people in Hà Nội use motorbikes every day. They worried about the cost of new electric motorbikes. But many people also want clean air.

fluency.band6: Clear facts, with a reported-speech error.
fluency.band9: Announcement (accurate, past perfect) → how it spread → stakeholders → why people cared (real questions) → personal view → conclusion.

grammar.band6: Error: “the government said that petrol motorbikes will not be allowed” (would not be allowed).
grammar.band9: Reported speech with backshift (the government had asked…; would be phased out), relative clauses with “whose” (riders whose income depends on them), and indirect questions turned into direct ones for effect.

analysis.keyDifference: Band 6 error: “the government said that petrol motorbikes will not be allowed” should backshift in reported speech (would not be allowed). Band 9 reports the news accurately with past perfect, shows how it spread, lists stakeholders, and explains the public interest with real questions.

part3.question: Do you think local news is more important than international news? Why?

segments.v: I think local news is more important because it affects our daily life.

For daily life, yes. Local news tells you things you can act on: road closures, water cuts, school changes, or new rules like the motorbike plan. But international news shapes the bigger picture. A war or an economic

part3.question: Why are some news stories more popular than others?

segments.v: Because some stories are interesting or shocking. Stories about famous people are also popular.
Stories spread when they touch people personally, like the motorbike plan, which affected almost everyone.
is another key factor; stories that make people angry, afraid or moved get shared much more than
surprise and celebrities all attract attention, and stories with strong images or videos travel faster. Social media
so the most emotional stories often win, even if they're not the most important.
